dct_title_s: Moraviae : nova et post omnes priores accuratissima delineatio
dct_description_sm: auctore I. A. Comenio ; A. Goos sculpsit.
Bar scale given in "Com[m]unia Geographica Moravica".
Cartouche, left: Illustrisso Do Lad. Welenio de Zerotin, Luntenburgi, Treboviae, Hanstadij, et Ruddae, Domino, gratissimo Domino meo ...
Dedication at bottom of cartouche, left: Illustrisse magtie tue addictissimus
With four city views: Polna; Olmuts; Brin; and Znaim.
Campbell, T. C.J. Visscher, 100 maps (Map Collector's Circle, no. 46 (1968)), 56.
